moments.name: 32.Qxc5
moments.headline: 32.Qxc5!! A real sacrifice: White gives up material and the engine still rates it best.
points: Leaves the rook on e4 where it can be taken.

why.title: The idea
why.text: 32.Qxc5!! leaves the rook on e4 hanging. Taking it still leaves White level.

why.title: What White gives up
why.text: 32.Qxc5 leaves the rook on e4 hanging to the rook on f4. That's a whole rook on offer.

why.title: What it does instead
why.text: It takes the bishop on c5. Black has no bishop left to guard the dark squares around the king (f8, h8).

why.title: If Black takes the rook
why.text: 32…Rxe4 is met by 33.Qc2, threatening Qxe4, winning a rook. Then 34.dxe6 takes the e6 pawn. White is two pawns down: White holds the balance (−0.11). This is Black's best try.

moments.name: 33…Rc8

points: The rook takes the open c-file, aiming at the queen on c5.

33…Rc8 wins the queen for a rook, picking it up with 34…Qxc8.
Sets up a sequence and wins the queen for a rook once the captures settle, picking it up with 34…Qxc8.
White answers 34.Qxc8, taking the rook on c8.
